structured.answer: I'd open a securities account at פסגות ניירות ערך and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund that the page marks "הזול". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ put in), it says I'd end up with about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", assuming 2% inflation a year and 7% return.

stuck.why: No number showed for inflation on the main screen. I only found the 2% by tapping the 'אינפלציה' button, which opened a box that also looks like something you can edit.
The colour legend sits below the bars and is tiny. I guessed the big pink part is 'מס' (tax).
